summary: The change renames the provider operation to `removeAppVm` and refuses to remove any app ID that is a registered main workspace. It also adds the `rm` command to Exe's signed permissions, which fixes app VM removal. Round 2 fixes all three earlier findings: new tests cover the template name-conflict cleanup, with and without a workspace collision, and a successful cancel; the type-only interface lines have a coverage-exempt reason again. All tests pass, every changed line is covered or exempt, and no findings remain, so the change is ready.
